title: Malicious code in @callmewanz/bails (npm)
description: The npm package @callmewanz/bails version 1.0.0 declares a dependency on libsignal via a GitHub repository reference without a fixed commit SHA, tag, or semantic version. This means that on installation, npm fetches the current default branch of the referenced GitHub repository and executes any lifecycle scripts it contains without integrity checks or version pinning. As a result, whoever controls the GitHub repository can execute arbitrary code on the installer's machine during installation, potentially changing the code silently between installs.
